claims.statement: Atlassian describes permission-aware behavior for interactive Rovo use; automation can use the connecting user's context; connector behavior needs separate review.
The data contribution FAQ describes changes effective August 17, 2026 and organization-level settings.
The AI transparency material gives context about model and data handling.
